metadata.title: Data Handling and Use

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for defining institution-wide rules governing how data may be accessed, processed, and shared.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Policy frameworks, rule definitions, and control logic governing permissible data use.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for establishing allowable and prohibited data behaviors independent of application execution context.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Data handling rules depend on established data sensitivity and obligations.

metadata.remarks: Data Handling and Use defines global, policy-level constraints on how institutional data may be accessed, processed, transformed, or shared. These rules define allowable use in principle and must be enforced by applications, integrations, and platforms.

components.title: Access and Use Rules
components.description: Defines who may access data and under what institutional conditions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid credentials to access data beyond permitted conditions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access control policies that constrain data usage contexts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies restrict data access to authorized roles and contexts.
Least privilege principles apply to data access.

components.title: Processing and Transformation Rules
components.description: Governs permitted processing, analytics, and transformation of data.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Improper processing or manipulation of data leading to misuse or misrepresentation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement governing permissible data transformations.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define acceptable processing and analytic use of data.

components.title: Sharing and Disclosure Rules
components.description: Defines constraints on internal and external data sharing.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exfiltration of data through unauthorized sharing paths.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy constraints limiting where and how data may be disclosed.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Controls reduce risk of unauthorized data dissemination.

components.title: Purpose Limitation
components.description: Restricts data use to explicitly approved purposes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Secondary use of data beyond the originally approved purpose.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement tying data use to approved purposes.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data use is restricted to defined and approved purposes.
